finding: Caesarean section was not found to be superior to vaginal birth in terms of preserving normal sexual function after 6 months postpartum.
mod_finding: While vaginal birth with mediolateral episiotomy was associated with lower satisfaction and higher pain levels at 3 months postpartum, none of the FSFI domains differed between caesarean and vaginal birth groups at 6, 12, or 24 months.
